details:
Currently, the only way to obtain VRChat Plus is through direct purchase. While this provides consistent support for the platform, it limits access for users who may not be able to afford a subscription but still want to experience the benefits it offers.

A potential solution would be to introduce a challenge and mission system where players can complete in-world activities to earn temporary access to VRChat Plus. These activities could include:

- Completing missions within game-focused or exploration worlds

- Taking photos using VRChat’s camera system

- Spending a certain amount of active time online

- Adding friends or being added by others

- Participating in community-driven events

By completing these tasks, users could earn 1–7 days of VRChat Plus per month. This system would provide several benefits:

- Accessibility – Users who cannot afford a subscription still get to enjoy VRChat Plus features, even if only for short periods.

– Encourages players to spend more time in VRChat worlds, exploring content and engaging socially.

- Conversion Potential – Gives users a taste of VRChat Plus benefits, increasing the likelihood they eventually purchase a subscription.

- Community Growth – Incentivizes social interaction and participation, which strengthens VRChat’s player base.

This approach would not replace subscriptions but rather complement them by acting as both a trial system and a reward mechanism. It ensures more users can experience VRChat Plus firsthand, which could drive long-term growth in both the community and the service itself.
title: VRChat Plus Access Through Challenges and Missions
